sentences.text: In short: HELLER ENTREPRENØR AS is an established small company in "oppføring av bygninger" based in Indre Østfold, loss-making in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
HELLER ENTREPRENØR AS describes itself on its website as: "Heller Entreprenør AS – Byggefirma i Askim med over 40 års erfaring innen prosjektledelse, byggesøknader og konstruksjonsarbeid".
HELLER ENTREPRENØR AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1982-01-01, registered in Indre Østfold.
It has 19 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 23.43M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 348,440 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -1.5% and negative equity of -NOK 264,959 (liabilities exceed assets).

Revenue fell 22.6% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 30.29M to NOK 23.43M); it was NOK 13.84M in 2023. The annual result went from a profit in 2024 to a loss in 2025 (2023: NOK 1.28M, 2024: NOK 196,773, 2025: -NOK 634,779).
HELLER ENTREPRENØR AS is led by CEO Ole Christian Heller and board chair Steinar Ove Heller.
It has a board of 3. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2024-09-27.
HELLER ENTREPRENØR AS has a verified website (https://hellerentreprenor.no/) and 1 registered workplace.
